What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `openssl`: OpenSSL 3.5.9: doc/man7/EVP_KDF-ARGON2.pod states that Argon2i's memory accesses are independent of the data and Argon2d's depend on it, and states no constant-time property.

`kdfs::argon2d` has no default backend: the call names one of its backends (<<hash-default-backend>>).

The default of `kdfs::argon2i` is `sodium`, whose cell comes with a later increment: until then a call on the default stops at compile time, and a call names a backend of the table (<<hash-default-backend>>).

The default of `kdfs::argon2id` is `sodium`, whose cell comes with a later increment: until then a call on the default stops at compile time, and a call names a backend of the table (<<hash-default-backend>>).
